name: token-monitor-embedded
description: Portable local Codex telemetry in an embedded panel, powered by a bundled Node runtime.

interface.longDescription: Local token usage, per-call API-equivalent cost, thread input/output and reasoning totals, cache status, allowances, compaction, history, and tool attribution. Bundled Node runtime for macOS and Windows. Opens once per local chat; refreshes directly without model turns.
